findings.title: Publicly logged hostnames suggest exposed admin/legacy/staging systems

evidence.excerpt: CT logs list 12 unique hostnames with 1 risky hostname: staging.copperline.example matched pattern 'staging', first_seen 2025-03-02, last_seen 2026-09-15.

findings.deal_impact: A publicly discoverable staging hostname may expose a less-hardened environment with supply-chain analytics data; diligence should confirm staging isolation, authentication, and whether it holds production data before closing.

remediation.summary: Verify staging.copperline.example is intentional, authenticated, isolated from production, and contains no production data; remove or restrict public exposure if not required.

items.action: Verify staging.copperline.example is intentional, authenticated, isolated from production, and contains no production data; remove or restrict public exposure if not required.

deal_recommendations.text: Before closing and within Days 0–30, obtain the current SOC 2 Type II report and complete a management security interview before reliance on the B rating [F-001].

Require IT Ops to verify staging.copperline.example is intentional, authenticated, isolated from production, and contains no production data, completing remediation in Days 61–100 at $10K–$50K [F-001].
No price adjustment is warranted, as total remediation of $10K–$50K in Days 61–100 is immaterial relative to revenue [F-001].

narrative.executive_summary: Bottom line: Proceed with conditions. Copperline is rated B at 98.4 based on the single identified outside-in finding, with confidence limited because only limited outside-in evidence was available [F-001]. Key risks: A publicly discoverable staging hostname requires confirmation of isolation, authentication, and data separation. Govern, Detect, and Recover were not assessed, and the review was passive and outside-in only. No SOC 2 report was provided [F-001]. Management credibility: Not assessed: no management interview provided. Next steps: Obtain the current SOC 2 Type II report and a management security interview, and confirm staging isolation, authentication, and data separation before relying on the rating [F-001].
key_questions_for_management: Provide evidence that staging.copperline.example is intentional, authenticated, isolated from production, and contains no production data [F-001]?
Provide the current SOC 2 Type II report for review before reliance on the rating [F-001]?
Confirm the scope and coverage for Govern, Detect, and Recover, which were not assessed in the provided inputs [F-001]?
Confirm the accountable owner and planned timeline for removing or restricting public exposure of staging.copperline.example where it is not required [F-001]?

limitations: Unassessed CSF functions (no evidence from provided inputs): GV, DE, RC
Passive outside-in assessment only; no authenticated or internal testing
KEV matches are product-level; versions not verified
